newsitem.title: USA: Anacomp sells 28 systems to Kodak.
newsitem.headline: Anacomp sells 28 systems to Kodak.

text.p: Anacomp Inc on Friday announced a multi-million dollar sale for 28 XFP 2000 systems to Eastman Kodak Co's business imaging systems division, marking the largest product order in company history.
The XFP 2000 processes computer output into microfilm.
Anacomp said Kodak plans to resell the systems to First Image Management Co. The deal also calls for Anacomp to provide supplies and maintenance services to First Image.
Kodak's also agreed to purchase spare parts from Anacomp for use in previously purchased systems.
